subject.title: WhatsApp inbound messages not received in k3s nested container (outbound works)

question: Should this broad WhatsApp external-inbound-loss tracker be solved with active liveness verification, provider-side history/backfill, warning-only diagnostics, or the current bounded append-only recovery?
rationale: Current main has a partial fix for events Baileys already emits, but the reported failure is that external inbound events stop entirely; the next step affects privacy, replay bounds, read receipts, config/default behavior, and live proof expectations.

options.title: Design combined recovery policy
options.body: Keep this issue canonical and coordinate active liveness, bounded monitored-chat backfill, durable dedupe, and unrecoverable-gap warnings before implementation.

options.title: Split after live proof
options.body: Use a live WhatsApp reproduction to decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50093 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93406 should become canonical for the remaining root cause.

options.title: Warn only
options.body: Decline automatic recovery for now and add explicit diagnostics that tell operators when WhatsApp appears connected but inbound delivery cannot be proven.

recommendation.title: Design combined recovery policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical and coordinate active liveness, bounded monitored-chat backfill, durable dedupe, and unrecoverable-gap warnings before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The durable inbound and PR 80642 history make steipete the best available routing candidate for the recovery-policy decision.
